data.narrative:
Lambda is a Series E AI & Software company that has raised $3.15B to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies: Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), SandboxAQ ($5.8B, Series E), and Ayar Labs ($3.8B, Series E).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $3.1B total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.4x multiplier typical for Series E advancement, yielding $4.4B. Peer-median analysis calculates the median valuation across the four comparable companies at $7.2B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $15.0B. The dispersion reflects stage variance and heterogeneity within frontier AI—Applied Intuition trades at a Series F premium while Ayar Labs, at Series E, sits nearer the lower bound.

Triangulating these methods produces a range of $3.7B (low) to $8.3B (high), with a median of $5.8B. This range reflects tension between the stage-progression method, anchored to capital deployed, and peer comps, which show material valuation spread even at equivalent rounds. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency metrics not provided in this dataset, the appropriate discount/premium for Lambda relative to the peer set, and whether the peer group adequately reflects current frontier-tech market conditions. The $5.8B median represents a reasonable point estimate given available data.
